data.name: Riannon
data.long_meaning: The name Riannon is derived from the Welsh language and means 'little queen'. In Welsh mythology, Riannon was a queen who bore twins by a mysterious lover. After her children were born, she was accused of infanticide and was cursed to carry them on her back for the rest of her life.
